question: For each mailing list, list its owner, owner type, the member visibility ('Public Members' if public, and 'Hidden Members' otherwise), and the number of members of this type of visibility. For each owner and owner type, include a grand total for all members in the format of (owner, owner type, null, total members).
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "moira_list" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_name" AS "moira_list_name", "is_public" AS "is_public", "is_hidden" AS "is_hidden" FROM beaver."moira_list";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "moira_list_owner" AS SELECT "moira_list_owner_key" AS "moira_list_owner_key", "owner" AS "owner", "owner_type" AS "owner_type" FROM beaver."moira_list_owner";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "moira_list_detail" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_owner_key" AS "moira_list_owner_key", "moira_list_member" AS "moira_list_member" FROM beaver."moira_list_detail";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.moira_list_key,
        d.moira_list_owner_key,
        d.moira_list_member,
        l.moira_list_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(l.is_public,'N') = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members'
            ELSE 'Hidden Members'
        END AS member_visibility
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    JOIN moira_list l
      ON d.moira_list_key = l.moira_list_key
), with_owner AS (
    SELECT
        b.moira_list_key,
        b.moira_list_name,
        b.member_visibility,
        o.owner,
        o.owner_type
    FROM base b
    JOIN moira_list_owner o
      ON b.moira_list_owner_key = o.moira_list_owner_key
), per_list AS (
    SELECT
        moira_list_name AS list_name,
        owner,
        owner_type,
        member_visibility,
        COUNT(*) AS members
    FROM with_owner
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
), owner_totals AS (
    SELECT
        NULL AS list_name,
        owner,
        owner_type,
        NULL AS member_visibility,
        COUNT(*) AS members
    FROM with_owner
    GROUP BY 2,3
)
SELECT * FROM per_list
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM owner_totals
ORDER BY owner, owner_type, list_name NULLS LAST, member_visibility NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH list_visibility AS (
    SELECT 
        l.moira_list_key,
        l.moira_list_name,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.is_public,'N') = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS member_visibility
    FROM moira_list l
), list_members AS (
    SELECT d.moira_list_key, d.moira_list_member, d.moira_list_owner_key
    FROM moira_list_detail d
), list_owner AS (
    -- assume one owner per (list, owner_key); pick any owner string
    SELECT d.moira_list_key, d.moira_list_owner_key, o.owner, o.owner_type
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT moira_list_key, moira_list_owner_key FROM moira_list_detail
    ) d
    LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner o
      ON d.moira_list_owner_key = o.moira_list_owner_key
), with_all AS (
    SELECT 
        lv.moira_list_name AS list_name,
        lo.owner,
        lo.owner_type,
        lv.member_visibility,
        lm.moira_list_member
    FROM list_members lm
    JOIN list_visibility lv ON lm.moira_list_key = lv.moira_list_key
    LEFT JOIN list_owner lo ON lm.moira_list_key = lo.moira_list_key
)
, per_list AS (
    SELECT 
        list_name,
        owner,
        owner_type,
        member_visibility,
        COUNT(*) AS members
    FROM with_all
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
, owner_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        NULL AS list_name,
        owner,
        owner_type,
        NULL AS member_visibility,
        COUNT(*) AS members
    FROM with_all
    GROUP BY 2,3
)
SELECT * FROM per_list
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM owner_totals
ORDER BY owner NULLS LAST, owner_type NULLS LAST, list_name NULLS LAST, member_visibility NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH list_base AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(l.moira_list_key) AS list_key,
    TRIM(l.moira_list_name) AS list_name,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(l.is_public),'N')='Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS member_visibility
  FROM moira_list l
), members AS (
  SELECT TRIM(m.moira_list_key) AS list_key,
         TRIM(m.moira_list_owner_key) AS owner_key,
         m.moira_list_member AS member
  FROM moira_list_detail m
), owners AS (
  SELECT TRIM(o.moira_list_owner_key) AS owner_key,
         o.owner,
         o.owner_type
  FROM moira_list_owner o
), with_all AS (
  SELECT 
    b.list_name,
    o.owner,
    o.owner_type,
    b.member_visibility,
    m.member
  FROM members m
  JOIN list_base b ON m.list_key = b.list_key
  LEFT JOIN owners o ON m.owner_key = o.owner_key
)
, per_list AS (
  SELECT 
    list_name,
    owner,
    owner_type,
    member_visibility,
    COUNT(*) AS members
  FROM with_all
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
, owner_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    NULL AS list_name,
    owner,
    owner_type,
    NULL AS member_visibility,
    COUNT(*) AS members
  FROM with_all
  GROUP BY 2,3
)
SELECT * FROM per_list
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM owner_totals
ORDER BY owner NULLS LAST, owner_type NULLS LAST, list_name NULLS LAST, member_visibility NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH list_base AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(moira_list_key) AS list_key,
    moira_list_name AS list_name,
    CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(TRIM(is_public),'N'))='Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS member_visibility
  FROM moira_list
), members AS (
  SELECT TRIM(moira_list_key) AS list_key,
         TRIM(moira_list_owner_key) AS owner_key,

), owners AS (
  SELECT TRIM(moira_list_owner_key) AS owner_key,
         owner,
         owner_type

), joined AS (
  SELECT 
    b.list_name,
    o.owner,
    o.owner_type,
    b.member_visibility,
    m.moira_list_member
  FROM members m
  INNER JOIN list_base b ON m.list_key = b.list_key
  LEFT JOIN owners o ON m.owner_key = o.owner_key
)
SELECT

  owner,
  owner_type,
  member_visibility,
  COUNT(*) AS members

  NULL AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(*) AS members
FROM joined
GROUP BY 2,3
ORDER BY owner NULLS LAST, owner_type NULLS LAST, list_name NULLS LAST, member_visibility NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH detail AS (
  SELECT TRIM(moira_list_key) AS list_name_proxy,
         TRIM(moira_list_owner_key) AS owner_key,
         moira_list_member
  FROM moira_list_detail
), owners AS (
  SELECT TRIM(moira_list_owner_key) AS owner_key,
         owner,
         owner_type
  FROM moira_list_owner
), joined AS (
  SELECT d.list_name_proxy AS list_name,
         o.owner,
         o.owner_type,
         -- Without a reliable join to moira_list for is_public, default visibility to Hidden Members as conservative proxy
         'Hidden Members' AS member_visibility,
         d.moira_list_member AS member
  FROM detail d
  LEFT JOIN owners o ON d.owner_key = o.owner_key
)
-- Per-list breakdown
SELECT list_name, owner, owner_type, member_visibility, COUNT(*) AS members
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
UNION ALL
-- Owner-level grand totals (list_name NULL, visibility NULL)
SELECT NULL AS list_name, owner, owner_type, NULL AS member_visibility, COUNT(*) AS members
FROM joined
GROUP BY 2,3
ORDER BY owner NULLS LAST, owner_type NULLS LAST, list_name NULLS LAST, member_visibility NULLS LAST;
